Verb Can for Possibility
You use the verb can for possible situations or impossible situations. It is generally used to emphasize how something is possible in the present.

You use the modal verb can when there is a possibility that something could happen. For example, when you talk about a fact:

This business organization can be used as a business process model.
(you could copy the model used by the business)

The location of this company can provide many advantages.
(you predict there is a possibility for the company to be successful)

Remember that you use the base form of the main verb after the modal verb can, check the structure:

Subject + Modal verb CAN+ Base form main verb+ complement

For example:
It can be a great business idea.
The sociopolitical business model can take a long time to implement.

Keep in mind that modals verbs do not require conjugation, so you use can for all the subject pronouns, with no distinction. Look at these examples:

• I can invest in the business if he gets some more money.
• You can develop a better business strategy only by studying more.
• He can work for a sociopolitical business on vacation.
• She can analyze business facts better if she gets more information.
• It can be difficult to recover a failed business.
• We can support external parties if they get problems.
• They can apply better business strategies if they create new alliances.

What is a business?
A business is an organization that acquires or creates and sells or exchanges products or services. It involves the people who provide these services and products, as the employees.

Business definition can apply not only to government organizations but to commercial enterprises, as well as social or charitable enterprises; all of them interrelated to define the specific area of work. Let's see some of them:

images.text: Every time you talk about an entity that can offer services and products, you are talking about a business. The concept of a business can indicate the activity of any social or governmental organization, as well as any private or public enterprise. It is common to analyze businesses and make predictions based on real information when we examine customers' needs. In that way, a business fact can determine realities of business procedures. It's important to identify that there are different types of business facts. First, 'Facts of Life' keep a close relation with the nature of the business. Second, 'Facts of Policy' which refers to the rules, laws, or conventions to implement a constant regulation of the business. Lastly, 'Facts of Implementation' that can be the limitations of the business structure.

Now that you know about business facts, you can identify different business models. There's a long list of models, however, I mention here the most important: the business data model to organize business requirements for a database, the business process model to represent the business requirements, such as procedure guides, hiring employees, and developing prices. The business event model refers to the state of an entity, the interactions it has, and the events that a company can modify when they find a dissatisfied customer.

Moreover, the business location model emphasizes on facilities and transportation networks as well as communication, with the purpose of staff movement. There's also a business sociopolitical model which analyzes different parties and their relations with providers, end users, and competitors in the social sphere. So, you can think of a business considering a wide view of business models and facts. Remember, business involves much more than monetary investment, but a hard work to understand and use the appropriate information system.
